digest.component_or_area: review_kernel verify telemetry and code_review/plan_review consumer pipelines
propositions: code_review pipeline does not emit outcome_counts telemetry or record contract violations because it lacks a shared sink and outcome_counts helper that plan_review already has.

plan_review uses a private ContextVar-backed sink (collect_contract_violations/record_contract_violation/drain_contract_violations in orchestrator.py) to track and report verification contract violations, but code_review only logs errors without persisting the data.

outcome_counts tracking at the *_decide boundary must be derived from merged verification output (findings, raw_verifs, reshape) since per-chunk boundaries are lost after workflow engine merge, and unrecoverable is always 0 at this boundary.

Moving the contract-violation sink into review_kernel allows both pipelines to import and use the same implementation, activated around the workflow run in each pipeline's gate dispatch and drained into respective verdict coverage.

Adding a shared decide_outcome_counts() helper in review_kernel computes clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable from data available at the merged *_decide boundary and wires the result into both pipelines' coverage as outcome_counts.
